# ex: needParen adds parens when binary expr replaces X of type assertion
ex {
	var x int
	f(x) -> x + 1
}
-- x.go --
package p

func f(x int) interface{} { return nil }

func h(a int) {
	_ = f(a).(int)
}
-- stderr --
x.go:6:6: invalid operation: (a + 1) (value of type int) is not an interface
errors found after executing: ex { \ ...
-- stdout --

+++ new/x.go
